summary: Coos County lookout first built in the 1920s, rebuilt as a 16 x 16 foot ground cabin in 1942, and abandoned or destroyed in 1965; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 16 x 16 foot ground cabin with an 8 x 8 foot glassed cupola (1942 plans)
facts.status_note: Abandoned or destroyed in 1965; no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: lookouts named in newspaper items for 1945, 1950 and 1954; no end date in these sources

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's page say the lookout was built in the 1920s; the Forest Lookouts page documents a new lookout built in 1942. No source says whether the 1942 cabin replaced an earlier one.
The 1942 ODF annual report credits the association and says the Air Warning Service paid; a 1943 Coos Bay Times item credits the CCC with completing it.
The register and firelookout.com say abandoned in 1965; the Forest Lookouts page says destroyed in 1965.

notes_for_editor: Access is not stated in any source read, so no access key. A 2020 Elliott State Forest recreation map was in the cache under its title, but fetch_text found no Trail Butte text in it; a search snippet names a Trail Butte lookout hike on that map, which remains unverified. The Elliott secrets page does name Trail Butte twice: a 1956 photo caption of the old Trail Butte Lookout ground house, and a Cougar Pass sightline passage that mentions Trail Butte. It does not say whether Trail Butte was one of the four lookouts, so the story does not place it among them. The story's county comes from the register and firelookout.com (both Coos County, Oregon). Staffing names were left out of the story.
